_about: Appendix F of the build instructions as data: number, date, currency and name formats per locale, plus the weights of section 3 (held-out locales: weight 0, test_locale only). 'money': how an amount is written in a text cell ({n} = the number); 'money_formats': Excel number formats that show the currency; 'dates': the date styles the generator writes (D M Y = day month year, MON = a month name, ERA = a Japanese era); 'name_order': how split name columns are joined (section 6); 'usd_rate' and 'price_level' turn the activities' USD prices into local prices.
